title: Clinical Entries
description: Example OOJS schema modeling a clinical domain with inheritance and polymorphism. Demonstrates vertical (hierarchical/embedded) has-many relationships: an Encounter owns and embeds its ClinicalEntry findings directly in the JSON.

ClinicalEntry.title: Clinical Entry
ClinicalEntry.description: Abstract base type for all clinical entries. Cannot be instantiated directly — use Observation, Diagnosis, or Procedure.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: A measured clinical observation (e.g. vital sign, lab result).

Diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
Diagnosis.description: A clinical diagnosis coded with ICD-10.

Procedure.title: Procedure
Procedure.description: A clinical procedure performed on a patient.

Encounter.title: Encounter
Encounter.description: A clinical encounter containing multiple entries. The 'findings' property is a HAS-MANY VERTICAL (polymorphic) relationship: ClinicalEntry subtypes are embedded directly inside the Encounter JSON and fully validated as part of it. The Encounter owns its findings.

findings.description: HAS-MANY VERTICAL (polymorphic): any concrete ClinicalEntry subtype is accepted. Each item is embedded in the Encounter JSON and validated independently via discriminator dispatch.
